resourceBoundary.policy: Complete retained correlated cut disposition or typed refusal; no document/resource payload.

semantics: Cut one scene-root vector layer at an explicit u32 frame using its same-snapshot actual native resolved range. The same native owner copies complete authored frames/timing/Motion/controls, preserves original raw in point and markers, drops live time links, ends original at cut-1 and creates an adjacent ordinary unlocked second half with literal name suffix (2). Changed cut adds one revision/history entry and returns its stable layerUid. Outside range is no-op with no publication or redo loss. Fractional resolved in is compared losslessly; unrepresentable materialized out and unconsumed item/component/duplicator/nonroot/project-placement sources remain typed unavailable. Payload context IDs are bounded authored IDs; non-root does not activate another context owner. No optimistic JS/Paper writer or separate authority. UI/installed/render/export acceptance remains open.

examples.label: Actual cut owner: adjacent second layer, one revision and undo entry; installed acceptance pending
Outside actual resolved range: no publication, history or redo change
